node.statement: Left approximate inverse law. Since sigma(U) is in calU, product closeness gives ||mu(sigma(U),U)-sigma(U) bold-dot U||<=G_c*e. By inverse closeness and the multiplication estimate in 1.5, ||sigma(U) bold-dot U-U^dagger bold-dot U||<2G_c*e; and U^dagger bold-dot U=J by def-approximate-unitary-space. Thus ||mu(sigma(U),U)-J||<3G_c*e<=C_grp*e because C_grp>=8G_c.
